chunks: Abu Khadijah narrated from Abu Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:
Any man who goes to another man and borrows money from him while intending not to repay it, then he is a thief and a transgressor.

key_terms.اللِّصُّ: the thief; one who wrongfully takes another's property
key_terms.الْعَادِي: the transgressor; one who oversteps rightful bounds
key_terms.فَاسْتَقْرَضَ: sought a loan; borrowed money from another person
key_terms.مَالًا: wealth or property that is taken as a loan
key_terms.نِيَّتِهِ: his inner intention or deliberate resolve
key_terms.يُؤَدِّيَهُ: to repay it; to discharge what is owed

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about borrowing money with the intention of not repaying it?
ai.summary: This hadith condemns borrowing with the intention of withholding repayment. It equates such conduct with theft and transgression, emphasizing the sanctity of other people's property and the moral seriousness of dishonest financial dealings.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3689 - Abu Khadijah narrated from Abu Abdillah (as) who said:
"Any man who goes to another man and borrows money from him while intending not to repay it, then he is a thief and a transgressor."
